note: Versions of yaapi.bible a patch may use, checked by hand. Order = preference. `license` is what a person confirmed; the build fails if yaapi's own `license` field disagrees. yaapi's copyright text does not state the license version (4.0) for these two: the version is taken from the publishers' open-license terms and is to be confirmed.

excluded.VBL: licence field CCBYND, text says CC BY-SA 4.0 (contradiction)
excluded.BLT: licence field CCBYND, text says CC BY-SA 4.0 (contradiction)
excluded.TOJB: field CCBY but the copyright text has no license wording
excluded.ASV: field CCBYNC, text says public domain
excluded.BSB: field CCBYNCND, text says public domain
